title: China's Personal Information Protection Law takes effect
summary: The law, passed by the NPC Standing Committee on 20 August 2021, applies from 1 November 2021 and covers personal-information processing including automated decision-making.

title: Microsoft announces Azure OpenAI Service, giving selected cloud customers access to GPT-3 with content filtering
summary: At Ignite 2021 Microsoft said it would pick the first users itself and offer moderation tools alongside GPT-3, ForkLog reports.

title: Facebook says it will shut down its facial recognition system and delete templates of over 1 billion people
summary: The company said it would stop automatic face tagging in photos and videos, with the change rolling out over the following weeks.

title: Zillow says it will wind down Zillow Offers and cut about 25% of staff after a USD 421 million pre-tax loss on the unit
summary: CEO Rich Barton cited an inability to accurately forecast home prices; the company said it would end the program over several quarters and cut about 1,605 jobs.

title: Australia's information commissioner finds Clearview AI breached privacy law and orders it to delete images
summary: The determination says Clearview collected Australians' facial images without consent and must stop collecting them and destroy those it holds.

title: Sber releases ruDALL-E, a Russian-language text-to-image model, with a 1.3-billion-parameter version free to download
summary: A 12-billion-parameter version was also built, trained on 120 million text-image pairs on the Christofari supercomputer.

title: Alibaba's DAMO Academy unveils M6-10T, a multimodal model of about 10 trillion parameters, Qbitai reports
summary: According to the article, the model was trained on 512 GPUs in 10 days using DAMO's Whale framework and was already in use for the 11 November shopping festival.

title: Nvidia says it will make a very large language model available to enterprises
summary: VentureBeat reports the offering at Nvidia's November GTC event, building on the Megatron language-model work.

title: Putin tells the AI Journey conference that AI must be safe and serve people, calls for more digital specialists
summary: In his 12 November speech he said powerful AI technologies must work for the benefit of people and called for training programmes for digitalisation specialists.

title: UNESCO's 193 member states adopt a non-binding Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
summary: The text sets common values and principles for ethical AI development and leaves implementation to each state.

title: UK government publishes an algorithmic transparency standard for public-sector bodies
summary: The standard asks public-sector bodies to publish information about the algorithmic tools they use.

title: UK ICO announces provisional intent to fine Clearview AI about GBP 17 million and to order it to stop processing UK residents' data
summary: The regulator's provisional view is that Clearview breached UK data protection law; the company can still respond before a final decision.
